sources.title: nathandupont/mocov3-multitask · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Mocov3 for Multitask Overview This repository is a compact, custom PyTorch implementation of Mocov3 for Multitask. The tiny configuration is intended for code review, smoke tests, and small controlled experiments rather than as a production-ready pretrained release.

sources.title: Shtanaka/multitask · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview Working implementation of Mocov3 for Multitask using a tiny configuration. The repository focuses on transparent code and repeatable smoke tests; benchmark claims are deliberately omitted.
